verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents that it accepts transfers in, both single and bulk, and offers transfers through its API and WHMCS integration. The transfer page says a transfer includes a 1-year renewal, which hints at what happens to registration time. Beyond that, the evidence is marketing-level. missing for 10: documented EPP/auth-code steps, transfer status tracking, explicit transfer pricing, a clear statement that remaining registration time is preserved, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the transfer experience.
